europe_now.title: Netherlands condemns US sanctions on International Criminal Court officials
europe_now.summary: The Dutch government has sharply criticized the United States for imposing sanctions on senior International Criminal Court personnel, arguing that the measures undermine the rule of law and the court's independence. The move marks a rare public split between NATO allies over the prosecution of war crimes.

europe_now.title: Humanitarian crisis unfolds as thousands of unaccompanied minors live on streets of Ceuta
europe_now.summary: A Deutsche Welle investigation has found thousands of unaccompanied minors living without shelter, sanitation, or protection in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, highlighting systemic failures in the EU's border management. Spanish authorities and EU agencies face mounting pressure to address the dire conditions.

top_stories.title: Landmark trial against Meta begins over harm to young users
top_stories.summary: A landmark legal case against Meta has commenced in the United States, with plaintiffs alleging the company knowingly designed platforms that endanger the mental health of young users. The trial is expected to set a precedent for social media accountability worldwide.

top_stories.title: Russia deploys faster, deadlier drones in Ukraine war escalation
top_stories.summary: Russian forces are deploying upgraded Shahed drones with increased speed and lethality, according to a battlefield analysis by EUobserver. The tactical shift indicates an escalation in aerial warfare capabilities that could challenge Ukrainian air defenses.

europe_now.title: Thousands of minors stranded on Ceuta streets
europe_now.summary: Thousands of minors are stranded in Ceuta, living on the streets without adequate shelter or protection. The situation leaves them vulnerable to abuse and highlights a growing humanitarian crisis at Europe's borders.

top_stories.title: Netherlands criticizes US sanctions on ICC officials
top_stories.summary: The Netherlands condemned recent United States sanctions against senior International Criminal Court officials. The criticism underscores ongoing diplomatic friction between the allies over the court's operations.

top_stories.title: France expels Iranian diplomats amid diplomatic row
top_stories.summary: France announced the expulsion of two Iranian diplomats amid heightened tensions over arrests. The move reflects escalating diplomatic disputes between the European Union and Iran.

top_stories.title: Earthquake strikes Granada, causing injuries
top_stories.summary: An earthquake struck the historic Spanish city of Granada, causing injuries to three people. The tremor highlights the seismic risk in the region and prompts emergency response efforts.

top_stories.title: Sophie Adenot becomes first French woman to spacewalk
top_stories.summary: Sophie Adenot made history as the first French woman to perform a spacewalk. The achievement marks a milestone for French spaceflight and international collaboration on the International Space Station.
